description: LandBOSSE estimates the balance-of-system work and costs for installing utility-scale land-based wind plants. U.S. national-laboratory contributors publish a command-line model and a method report describing version 2.1.0. Inputs are wind-plant size, turbine and site design, construction methods, labour and equipment assumptions. Outputs are engineering activity and balance-of-system cost estimates for the specified project. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the project's location and construction scenario; the README does not claim a fixed national cost inventory. Apache-2.0 code is free, and the repository describes macOS and Windows use. A limitation is that site access, labour rates and procurement prices can make a published default estimate unsuitable for a particular project. LandBOSSE supports renewable-buildout and construction-capacity simulations. The catalogue's model-pypsa represents electrical-system operation, not wind-plant construction cost. No installation run or source data were downloaded.
